newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Malmo Aviation starts Stockholm-Angelholm route.
newsitem.headline: Malmo Aviation starts Stockholm-Angelholm route.

text.p: Swedish airline Malmo Aviation said on Thursday that it would start a new flight between Angelholm in southern Sweden and Stockholm's Bromma airport on August 1.
The airline said in a statement that the route would be served by a four engine jet plane with room for 96 passengers. There would be four flights daily.
Malmo Aviation currently runs flights from Malmo at the southern tip of Sweden to Bromma and to Gothenburg in western Sweden and to London's City airport.
Angelholm airport is used by about 310,000 passengers a year.
